item.title: Greenville police report lowest crime rates in 25 years
item.description: Greenville's crime rate has reached its lowest level in 25 years following a significant decline in violent and property offenses.

item.title: 2 dead, 1 injured in shooting at SC State University
item.description: Two people have been killed and one injured in a shooting at South Carolina State University. The university was placed on lockdown, and the South Carolina Law Enforcement Division has been called in to assist with the investigation. The shooting took place at an apartment complex in the Hugine Suites student residential complex. No suspect information has been released, and the victims have not been identified. Classes have been canceled for Friday.
